admission.justification: The intent-review outline receives the candidate-side derived standing and writer.

applicability: Current record standing in knowledge reading and the candidate side of the intent review.
conditions: The reader uses the standing and writer from the selected snapshot.
The knowledge reader's record detail can wrap.
exclusions: Baseline-only intent-review rows have no candidate standing.
The intent-review row remains one line.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_knowledge_read_record_standing.py (6 cases); dashboard/src/panels/knowledge-reader/TruthView.standing.test.tsx; dashboard/src/panels/review/tree/treeRows.test.tsx; mounted check at 1920 and 1440 (W4 evidence, F11)

statement: The reader's answers, the dashboard's knowledge reader (its record header, its record lists and the record list of its sidebar) and the intent review show each rule's state and its writer as role and model; an unconverted record reads proposed, written by unknown, and its old word is no status. In the sidebar the state and writer are the record row's own wrapping second line, so a narrow sidebar does not cut them.
